meta.name: deeptools
meta.description: NGS analysis toolkit. BAM to bigWig conversion, QC (correlation, PCA, fingerprints), heatmaps/profiles (TSS, peaks), for ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, ATAC-seq visualization.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将高通量测序数据转化为可视化分析图表
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在分析ChIP-seq、RNA-seq或ATAC-seq数据
copy.tagline_en: Transform high-throughput sequencing data into visualization and analysis
copy.fit_line_en: For you if analyzing ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, or ATAC-seq data

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 deepTools 命令处理测序数据:把 BAM 转成 bigWig 覆盖度轨道,做相关性、PCA、fingerprint 等质控,并绘制 TSS/峰区热图与剖面图;还会用自带脚本检查输入文件、生成工作流模板。
howto.when: 当你说出“BAM 转 bigWig”“做 ChIP 质控”“画 TSS 热图”等请求,或要求分析 ChIP-seq、RNA-seq、ATAC-seq 数据时,会接管处理。

say.text: 把 tumor.bam 转成 bigWig,用 RPGC 归一化。
say.note: 会调用 bamCoverage,生成归一化覆盖度轨道。

say.text: 生成一份 ChIP-seq 质控工作流脚本。
say.note: 会生成并运行 QC 脚本,输出相关性、PCA 等图。

say.text: 画一下 signal.bw 在 TSS 附近的热图。

howto.what_en: Claude uses deepTools to analyze NGS data: converts BAM to bigWig coverage tracks, runs QC (correlation, PCA, fingerprint), and plots heatmaps/profiles at TSS/peaks. It also validates input files and generates workflow scripts via bundled scripts.
howto.when_en: Activates when you ask for BAM-to-bigWig conversion, ChIP/RNA/ATAC analysis, QC, heatmaps, or use BAM/bigWig/BED files in a genomics context.

say_en.text: Convert tumor.bam to bigWig with RPGC normalization.
say_en.note: Runs bamCoverage to produce a normalized coverage track.

say_en.text: Generate a ChIP-seq QC workflow script.
say_en.note: Runs the workflow generator and executes QC steps.

say_en.text: Plot a heatmap around TSS for signal.bw.
